Title: Starting Over
Descriptions: Had enough of your faction? Relax, for a fee you can reset your faction and choose another path. Is this what you want to do?
You can only choose one faction so choose wisely. Speak to me again when you are ready.
ObjectiveText: Do you really want to reset your faction to 'Raiders'? This will reset your reputation but allow you to choose a different faction. If so bring Krusty 100,000 coins.
RequiredFaction: East, West, Civilian, Guards, Shaman, Passive
